title: Quick French Larb Mozzarella
description: A fusion twist on the classic French tartine, featuring a tangy and savory Thai-inspired larb topping made with quickly fermented ingredients.
instructions: Slice the mozzarella cheese into thin rounds.
Place the cheese on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown and melted.
While the cheese is baking, mix together the quickly fermented red cabbage, Thai basil, chili flakes, and fish sauce (if using) in a bowl.
Squeeze the lime juice over the cabbage mixture and toss to combine.
Once the cheese is done, remove it from the oven and top each round with a spoonful of the cabbage mixture.
